I ate there many times in 1968 when was owned by a single proprietor. It was a small restaurant near Continental Hotel
May 2021
The cannelloni with bechamel white sauce was fantastic, I believe it was made with water buffalo mozzarrella. I met an American soldier who ate there also. He had a food booth at the Pike Market in Seatle Washington.in 1983. He told me he got the recipe from the owner around 1965.and that he would mail it to me His wife told me acyear later on the phone that he had a hearth condition and died and they couldn't find the recipe at his mother's house when she died previously. I ate there about 30 times. I didn't see the dish listed on the menue at the present restaurant. Maybe I missed it.

Need more proper advise to organize well an event
May 2018 • Business
Went to La Dolce Vita Cafe & Bar - Continental Saigon Hotel for an event, hosted by foreigners. 
In general it was fine, cozy, relax. However there are 2 unprofessional issues. 
1. We asked where is La Dolce Vita Cafe & Bar in the reception, the receptionist answered quickly that we were in the wrong place “this is Continental hotel, not Intercontinental hotel”. 
Believe that there was no Café & Bar having the similar name “La Dolce Vita” in Intercontinental hotel. 
We repeated the name, then he considered it was a correct spelling, and showed us the direction.
Difficult entry requirement. 
2. Finger food in Café & Bar were cold (after 2 hours in aircon room), Spring rolls and French fries were also not crunchy, and there were no seasoning options. 
Spoke to Café manager, he said “the host required all food to be displayed on time”, but he could have advised the host more details how to display food in order to bring / show the food in good quality. 
There was no option that Café could provide warm containers to keep food warm and crunchy.
There was no option to warm up food immediately. 
When we needed seasoning selections, he brought am open bottle of chilly sauce – Cholimex!!
To maintain the competitive services requires extra steps and cares when communicate well to customers. 
Service is not only to serve, but remember to advise customers to manage their expectations.

Mature waiters, cloth tablecloths with old world peace and quiet.
Feb 2018 • Couples
What a find! Just outside the Cancun Hotel District along a busy highway you are into a refuge of quiet elegance and welcoming staff. I speak only English and my date from Venezuela only Spanish so our access to excellent internet to use Google Translate was a must. We were first seated at a nice private table seated across from each other, but when the waiter noticed we were struggling to pass my smartphone back and forth he suggested we move to a nearby table where we could sit closer to use the voice translator. The Spinach pasta with Camerones was excellent as was the pate' appetizer 
Service during our meal was just the right amount of attention mixed with respect for our privacy. Bravo La Solve Vitae.!

Nostalgia is this place's only salvation
May 2015 • Family
Came here for early evening drinks but more so to relish the history of Vietnam's oldest hotel and a living witness to Indochinese history. The place looks really tired and way past its sell-by date. Didn't grow old with grace at all. The alfresco area of the cafe is perfect for people watching but the menu is so unexciting, not to mention expensive and the hotel in itself aching for a much better rejuvenation. Shame as this could have been a really great place. 

I would recommend this place only for the sense of nostalgia it encapsulates and for the greatness it could have been if the hotel was in the hands of people who understand its true potential.
